slides.title: The four signals we hear most.
slides.lead: From our conversations across the industry over the past 12 months, the same themes keep surfacing.

bullets.text: Personalization stalled at the landing-page layer — every channel below is still batch.
Cross-channel orchestration is brittle. One change ripples for weeks.
The data is rich. The decisioning is poor.
AI pilots ran. Measurable ROI didn't.

bullets: Weeks to launch a new offer

cards.body: Unify every signal — web, app, CRM, offline — into a single customer profile that updates in milliseconds.
Orchestrate cross-channel experiences with AI-suggested next-best-actions and on-the-fly decisioning.
Measure outcomes — not just clicks — across every step of every journey.
